lines: Ranjish hi sahi, dil hi dukhane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even in resentment, even if only to wound my heart.

lines: Aa phir se mujhe chhod ke jaane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even if only to leave me again.

lines: Pehle se marasim na sahi, phir bhi kabhi to
couplets.en: Our old ties may be gone, but someday, even so.

lines: Rasm-o-rah-e-duniya hi nibhane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, if only to keep up the world's conventions.
How many people can I tell?

lines: Judai ka sabab hum kis kis ko batayenge
couplets.en: How many people must I tell why we parted?

lines: Tu mujh se khafa hai to zamane ke liye aa
couplets.en: If you are angry with me, come for the world's sake.

lines: Ranjish hi sahi, dil hi dukhane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even in resentment, even if only to wound my heart.

lines: Kuchh to mere pindar-e-mohabbat ka bharam rakh
couplets.en: Spare me a little of the pride I took in loving you.

lines: Tu bhi to kabhi mujh ko manane ke liye aa
couplets.en: For once, you too might come and make it up to me.

lines: Ranjish hi sahi, dil hi dukhane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even in resentment, even if only to wound my heart.

lines: Ek umr se hun lazzat-e-girya se bhi mahrum
couplets.en: For years, even the solace of tears has been denied me.

lines: Ai rahat-e-jan, mujh ko rulane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, my heart's comfort, if only to make me weep.

lines: Ranjish hi sahi, dil hi dukhane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even in resentment, even if only to wound my heart.

lines: Aa phir se mujhe chhod ke jaane ke liye aa
couplets.en: Come, even if only to leave me again.
